topic: How autonomous agents build an editable Premiere video
objective: Demonstrate a closed-loop Premiere workflow with licensed footage, native captions, structured critique, and a selected final revision.

request.topic: How autonomous agents build an editable Premiere video
request.viewer_problem: Automated videos often hide their decisions and produce uneditable exports.
request.core_promise: See a complete autonomous Premiere workflow that remains editable.
request.cta: Use the winning project as the starting point for the next production board.

scenes.title: Start With the Finished Result
scenes.script: Here is the result first: an autonomous agent opened Premiere, assembled licensed footage, created native captions, and exported an editable project.

scenes.title: Inspect the Evidence
scenes.script: Every production decision is structured and timecoded. The board records its brief, asset licenses, timeline events, quality checks, and exact revision requests.

scenes.title: Choose the Strongest Revision
scenes.script: The release arbiter compares every playable version and chooses the strongest score, not simply the newest edit. Use the winning project for the next production board.
